what: From 01286 (4): const_trait_derive_const still meets a recorded builtin derive impl in the evaluator although its harness sets set_expand_builtin_derives(true). eval.rs get_mir_or_dyn_index now names the derive, method and self type; needs one run of tests::consteval::const_traits::const_trait_derive_const to say which impl stays unexpanded, then the fix in name resolution or the harness.
